summary: Trump is reviewing limited strikes on southern Iran and in the Strait of Hormuz following Iranian missile launches at Jordan and attacks on US assets. Iranian air defenses shot down a US MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz, while the Israeli military has been placed on high alert. Meanwhile, Israeli air and artillery strikes continue across southern Lebanon with 144 alerts recorded in a single day.

sections.executive_summary: Trump is reviewing limited strikes on southern Iran and in the Strait of Hormuz following Iranian missile launches at Jordan and attacks on US assets. Iranian air defenses shot down a US MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz, while the Israeli military has been placed on high alert. Meanwhile, Israeli air and artillery strikes continue across southern Lebanon with 144 alerts recorded in a single day.

points: Axios reports Trump and senior advisors are reviewing limited strikes in the Strait of Hormuz to prevent Iran from rebuilding radar and missile capabilities to attack ships, a plan prepared by CENTCOM and supported by Defense Secretary Hegseth but not approved before weekend clashes; the goal is described as "cutting the grass" to reduce risk to tankers, US naval vessels, and aircraft (Source: @VahidOnline/78120).
An Iranian official told Fox News to wait for satellite images showing damages from overnight operations, indicating Iranian acknowledgment of strikes on its territory (Source: @kianmeli1/91304).

Trump posted an AI-generated video on Truth Social depicting Kharg Island "being leveled," hours after CENTCOM struck two missile launchers on Lark Island, signaling psychological warfare alongside kinetic action (Source: @VahidOnline/78117).

IRGC air defenses successfully intercepted and destroyed a US MQ-9 Reaper drone over the Strait of Hormuz, confirmed by Iranian state media and regional outlets (Source: @New_security8200/203506, @naya_foriraq/88892).
Three missiles were reportedly fired from Sirik in Hormozgan province toward the Strait of Hormuz, demonstrating Iranian missile readiness in the strategic waterway (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80052).
Electronic jamming operations are ongoing over the Persian Gulf, affecting communications and navigation in the region (Source: @shin_persian/9262).

Internal unrest persists: security forces opened fire on protesters in Gachsaran demonstrating against hiring practices at the Lishtar refinery, while the judiciary chief threatened harsher crackdowns as the dollar hit 210,000 tomans (Source: @kianmeli1/91298, @VahidOnline/78112).

Trump declared the US will "hit Iran hard" in response to Iranian missile launches targeting Jordan overnight, signaling imminent US military action with Israeli coordination (Source: @almogboker78/18088).
The Israeli military has been placed on high alert, with the army receiving readiness orders as US-Iran tensions escalate toward potential direct conflict (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80057).
Prime Minister Netanyahu met with Mossad chief Gopman Yinnon, though no operational details were disclosed (Source: @inon_yttach/9987).
A drone strike on a vehicle in Gaza caused casualties, according to local reports, indicating continued Israeli kinetic operations in the enclave (Source: @New_security8200/203502).
Gaza media reported deaths and injuries from an Israeli drone strike targeting a vehicle, though specific casualty numbers and location were not provided (Source: @New_security8200/203502).
Israeli air strikes hit Adshit al-Qasir in southern Lebanon, with live mapping confirming the targeting (Source: @redlinkleb/39826, @redlinkleb/39825).
An explosion from war remnants occurred in Habouch, Nabatieh district, highlighting ongoing unexploded ordnance risks (Source: @redlinkleb/39808).

Daily monitoring recorded 144 alerts, 108 drone sightings, 6 air strikes, and 13 artillery shelling incidents across southern Lebanon, with Nabatieh district most affected (52 alerts) followed by Tyre (39) and Jezzine (16) (Source: @redlinkleb/39835).
Artillery shelling targeted Beit Lif in the Nabatieh area, part of the 13 recorded shelling incidents (Source: @redlinkleb/39840).
An explosion was reported in Zoutr al-Sharqiya, with live mapping indicating a detonation event (Source: @redlinkleb/39832).

Satellite imagery reportedly shows an Iranian missile penetrated US air defenses at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan, striking an aircraft hangar, marking a significant escalation in Iranian missile accuracy (Source: @naya_foriraq/88893).
Multiple missiles were launched from Yemen toward Saudi-backed militia positions in Mocha, indicating continued Houthi offensive operations (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387893).
A widespread power outage hit parts of Baghdad after private generators were shut down, reflecting Iraq's fragile infrastructure amid regional tensions (Source: @naya_foriraq/88916).
Saudi Arabia plans to raise at least $8 billion in fresh loans as the US-Israel war on Iran severely impacts the kingdom's economy, according to a Press TV report (Source: @presstv/204967).

The European Union affirmed continued cooperation with the US and G7 to maintain pressure on Iran through economic measures, including the US-led "economic expulsion" campaign, ahead of the G20 meeting hosted by the US (Source: @VahidOnline/78111).

key_developments: Trump reviewing limited strikes on southern Iran and Strait of Hormuz per Axios, targeting Iranian radar and missile capabilities after weekend clashes (Source: @VahidOnline/78120).
IRGC shoots down US MQ-9 Reaper drone over Strait of Hormuz, confirmed by Iranian state media and regional sources (Source: @New_security8200/203506).
Israeli military placed on high alert as US prepares potential response to Iranian missile launches at Jordan (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80057).
CENTCOM struck two Iranian missile launchers on Lark Island prior to Trump's AI video threatening Kharg Island destruction (Source: @VahidOnline/78117).
Lebanon endures 144 alerts, 108 drone sightings, 6 air strikes, and 13 artillery shelling incidents in 24 hours across Nabatieh and Tyre sectors (Source: @redlinkleb/39835).
Saudi Arabia seeks $8 billion emergency loan amid economic fallout from US-Israel-Iran conflict (Source: @presstv/204967).
Satellite evidence indicates Iranian missile breached US defenses at Jordan's Muwaffaq Salti Air Base, hitting aircraft hangar (Source: @naya_foriraq/88893).
sections.threat_assessment: The operational tempo has shifted decisively toward direct US-Iran confrontation, with Trump actively reviewing kinetic options against Iranian territory and maritime assets in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran's demonstrated ability to penetrate US air defenses in Jordan and down an MQ-9 over the Strait signals improved missile and air defense capabilities, raising the cost of any US strike package. Israel's high alert posture indicates expectation of Iranian retaliation on its territory or proxies, while Hezbollah's absorption of sustained Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon suggests a calibrated restraint to avoid widening the conflict. The internal Iranian unrest and economic collapse narrative amplified by Trump may aim to destabilize the regime but risks hardening Iranian resolve.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia's emergency $8 billion borrowing underscores acute economic anxiety among Gulf states over conflict spillover, while the EU's endorsement of the US "economic expulsion" campaign signals Western unity on maximum pressure. Jordan's silence on the Muwaffaq Salti base strike suggests containment priorities, but the breach of its airspace by Iranian missiles complicates its neutrality. Lebanon's daily barrage of Israeli strikes and drone surveillance indicates a sustained degradation campaign against Hezbollah infrastructure without triggering full-scale war. Iraq's power crisis reflects systemic fragility exacerbated by regional instability.
sections.intelligence_notes: The convergence of AI-generated disinformation (Trump's Kharg Island video) with actual kinetic strikes (Lark Island launchers) marks a new phase of cognitive warfare accompanying physical operations. The specific targeting of radar and missile capabilities in the Strait of Hormuz suggests a US strategy of "mowing the grass" to secure shipping lanes without regime change. Iran's missile launch from Sirik toward the Strait and successful MQ-9 intercept demonstrate layered defense and localized offensive readiness. The Gachsaran protests and judiciary threats reveal domestic pressure points the US may exploit. Satellite verification of the Jordan base strike would be a critical intelligence milestone confirming Iranian precision strike evolution.
